purpose: Define a professional EWD repository landing page using the shared scientific-model suite shell while preserving the canonical World3-03 System Dynamics paradigm and empirical/scenario interpretation boundaries.

canonical_identity.plain_language_purpose: EWD combines the World3-03 System Dynamics structure with observed data, reproducible calibration artifacts, validation checks and explicit provenance.
canonical_identity.technical_identity: An empirical System Dynamics model based on the World3-03 structural core, with separate empirical observation, calibration, selection and validation layers.
canonical_identity.paradigm_boundary: The World3-03 structural core remains the System Dynamics model. Empirical fitting, production refits, diagnostics and extensions do not silently redefine or validate the feedback structure.

current_public_state.central_model_status: experimental scenario model; not a probabilistic forecast
current_public_state.central_trajectory_rule: trajectory medoid of admissible production candidates
current_public_state.holdout_interpretation: 2019-latest belongs to the model-selection procedure; the displayed production trajectory is a separate post-validation refit
current_public_state.uncertainty_interpretation: P10-P90 is a pointwise structural sensitivity envelope, not a calibrated probability or confidence interval
current_public_state.extension_status: candidate extensions inactive unless explicit promotion gates pass

first_page_order: What EWD establishes and does not establish

conceptual_figure.layout: World3-03 structural core -> empirical observation/provenance -> calibration and candidate selection -> validation and sensitivity -> candidate extension gates
prohibited: drawing inactive candidate extensions as part of the central loop structure
implying that empirical fit validates every World3 feedback
